prompt: What is the title of the song that had the second highest record sales recorded on the Discography of American Historical Recordings in the same year that Fred J. Rath was elected mayor of Utica?
answer:
The song was **“Blue Skies.”**

Fred J. Rath was elected mayor of Utica in **1927**, and in that year “Blue Skies” had the **second-highest recorded sales** in the Discography of American Historical Recordings, behind Gene Austin’s “My Blue Heaven.”
